segments.en: Hello, English learners.
segments.zh: 各位英语学习者，大家好。

segments.en: Welcome back to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 欢迎回到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: Katarina And my name is Katarina.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜，我的名字是卡塔琳娜。

segments.en: So Marco, you've been shopping a lot lately.
segments.zh: 所以马可，你最近经常购物。

segments.en: Marco I have.
segments.zh: 马可：确实。

segments.en: And this dialogue or this lesson today is one of my favorite pieces of furniture, maybe appliances that I've bought recently, and it's a TV.
segments.zh: 今天的对话或这一课是我最喜欢的家具之一，也许是我最近买的电器，它是一台电视。

segments.en: Katarina All right.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜 好吧。

segments.en: So I'd even go for electronics with that one.
segments.zh: 所以那个甚至该算电子产品了。

segments.en: The electronics department is somewhere you like to hang out.
segments.zh: 电子产品区就是你喜欢逛的地方。

segments.en: Marco Uh-huh.
segments.zh: 马可：嗯哼。

segments.en: I mean, I think every guy loves, you know, like a big screen TV and a home theater system.
segments.zh: 我是说，我觉得每个男人都喜欢，你知道，大屏幕电视和家庭影院系统。

segments.en: So you just like go deaf after watching.
segments.zh: 看完之后你耳朵都要聋了。

segments.en: Katarina Why is that?
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜为什么会这样？

segments.en: Is bigger really better when it comes to like a 70 inch TV?
segments.zh: 像 70 英寸的电视一样，更大的真的更好吗？

segments.en: Marco Well, I don't know.
segments.zh: 马可 好吧，我不知道。

segments.en: I think, yeah, the whole experience of just seeing this movie on this huge TV and like having all the sound and I don't know, it's just something about that or watching a football game with your buddies and you can actually watch.
segments.zh: 我想，是的，在这台巨大的电视上看这部电影，喜欢拥有所有声音的整个体验，我不知道，这只是关于这一点，或者和你的朋友一起看足球比赛，你真的可以看。

segments.en: Katarina Oh, fun.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜哦，有趣。

segments.en: Okay, that I can appreciate.
segments.zh: 好吧，我可以欣赏。

segments.en: But we've got a couple of great words for you.
segments.zh: 不过我们为你们准备了几个很棒的词。

segments.en: We're going to preview in today's vocabulary preview.
segments.zh: 我们将在今天的词汇预览中进行预览。

segments.en: Vocabulary Preview.
segments.zh: 词汇预览。

segments.en: Marco Okay, so on vocabulary preview today, we're going to be looking at two words.
segments.zh: Marco 好的，所以今天的词汇预览，我们将看两个词。

segments.en: The first one is to appreciate.
segments.zh: 第一个是欣赏。

segments.en: Alright.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So this basically means to like.
segments.zh: 所以这基本上意味着喜欢。

segments.en: Marco Yeah, you appreciate someone.
segments.zh: 马可 是的，你很欣赏某人。

segments.en: But in this context, to enjoy or take advantage of something.
segments.zh: 但在这种情况下，享受或利用某事。

segments.en: So...
segments.zh: 那么……

segments.en: Katarina Maybe you hear this with a couple, two people who are fighting and the girl says to the guy, you don't appreciate me.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜：比如一对情侣吵架时，女孩会对男的说，你根本不懂得珍惜我。

segments.en: So he doesn't really care about her in the way that she wants him to.
segments.zh: 所以他并没有像她希望他那样真正关心她。

segments.en: Or you could say this about a TV, for example, I can't appreciate my PS3, my great, awesome console, my gaming system, because my TV is not good enough.
segments.zh: 或者你也可以用在电视上，比如，我没法充分体验我的 PS3、我那台超棒的游戏机，因为我的电视不够好。

segments.en: Marco Or big enough.
segments.zh: 马可或足够大。

segments.en: Katarina Or big enough.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜或足够大。

segments.en: Or big enough.
segments.zh: 或足够大。

segments.en: So this means that it could be a lot better if I just bought a better TV.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着如果我只是买了一台更好的电视，它可能会好很多。

segments.en: Marco Right.
segments.zh: 马可对。

segments.en: And if you buy a better TV, then you basically are upgrading or to upgrade.
segments.zh: 如果你买了一台更好的电视，那你基本上就是在升级，也就是 to upgrade。

segments.en: Katarina Okay, so this verb to upgrade means to go from something that's okay to something that's better.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜：好，这个动词 upgrade 的意思是从“还可以”变成“更好”。

segments.en: Marco Exactly.
segments.zh: 马可确切地说。

segments.en: So in previous lessons, we've seen to get a complimentary upgrade, for example, on a flight or in a hotel.
segments.zh: 因此，在之前的课程中，我们已经看到免费升级，例如在航班或酒店中。

segments.en: Katarina I like that.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜 我喜欢这样。

segments.en: Well, you can also get an upgrade on a computer.
segments.zh: 好吧，您也可以在计算机上进行升级。

segments.en: You say, well, my computer's from 1994.
segments.zh: 你说，嗯，我的电脑是 1994 年的。

segments.en: I really need to get an upgrade.
segments.zh: 我真的需要升级。

segments.en: Marco Yeah, for sure.
segments.zh: 马可 是的，当然。

segments.en: So to upgrade.
segments.zh: 所以升级。

segments.en: Now, we're going to be listening to this dialogue for the first time, we're going to be buying a TV.
segments.zh: 现在，我们将第一次听这个对话，我们要买一台电视。

segments.en: So let's listen.
segments.zh: 那么我们来听听。

segments.en: Katarina Seriously, I don't know why we need to get a new TV.
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜：说真的，我不明白我们为什么要换电视。

segments.en: Marco Honey, I told you already.
segments.zh: 马可：亲爱的，我已经跟你说过了。

segments.en: I can't appreciate the graphics level and detail of the games on my PlayStation 3 on our old TV.
segments.zh: 用咱们的旧电视，根本看不出 PlayStation 3 游戏的画质和细节。

segments.en: Good afternoon, folks, how can I be of service today?
segments.zh: 二位下午好，请问有什么可以帮您？

segments.en: I'm looking to upgrade to a newer, bigger television set.
segments.zh: 我想换一台更新、更大的电视。

segments.en: You've come to the right place.
segments.zh: 你来对地方了。

segments.en: What size are you looking for?
segments.zh: 你在找什么尺寸？

segments.en: Just a normal size TV for a living room.
segments.zh: 就是一台客厅用的普通尺寸电视。

segments.en: I see.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: Well, this set here is on sale.
segments.zh: 这台电视正在打折。

segments.en: It's a 46 inch HT TV screen and it has all the works three HDMI connectors, USB, VGA and S video ports.
segments.zh: 这是四十六英寸的 HT 电视，功能齐全：三个 HDMI 接口，还有 USB、VGA 和 S 视频接口。

segments.en: It even has a DVI port so you can hook up your PC or laptop.
segments.zh: 它甚至有一个 DVI 端口，因此您可以连接您的 PC 或笔记本电脑。

segments.en: This is without a doubt the complete home theater experience.
segments.zh: 毫无疑问，这是完整的家庭影院体验。

segments.en: This is exactly what I need.
segments.zh: 这正是我所需要的。

segments.en: Can you imagine watching movies or playing video games on this thing?
segments.zh: 想想看，用这台电视看电影、玩游戏得多过瘾。

segments.en: Katarina Honey, I think it's a bit too big.
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜：亲爱的，我觉得这台有点太大了。

segments.en: I don't even think it will fit in our living room.
segments.zh: 我甚至觉得咱们客厅都放不下。

segments.en: Not to worry.
segments.zh: 别担心。

segments.en: We will deliver and install it in your home.
segments.zh: 我们会送货上门并安装。

segments.en: It comes with a wall mount so you can just hang it on the wall like a picture.
segments.zh: 它配有壁挂支架，可以像挂画一样挂在墙上。

segments.en: This is great.
segments.zh: 这太棒了。

segments.en: How much will this set me back?
segments.zh: 这台要花我多少钱？

segments.en: Lucky for you, this is the last one we have in stock, so it's half off.
segments.zh: 您真走运，这是最后一台库存，可以打五折。

segments.en: I'll take it.
segments.zh: 我要这个。

segments.en: All right, so I'm going to have to defer to you, Marco, on some of these words in today's language takeaway because they're all about TV specifics.
segments.zh: 好吧，Marco，今天语言要点里的有些词我得请教你了，因为它们都跟电视的专业细节有关。

segments.en: Language takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: All right, the first word that we're going to be looking at is graphics, the graphics level.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们将要查看的第一个词是图形，图形级别。

segments.en: All right, so you might have heard this before with the phrase graphic designer, someone who designs images.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以你以前可能已经听说过图形设计师，即设计图像的人。

segments.en: But in this case, we're talking about graphics, so the way things appear on your TV.
segments.zh: 但在这种情况下，我们谈论的是图形，所以你的电视上会出现这种情况。

segments.en: So basically the pictures, right?
segments.zh: 所以基本上是图片，对吧？

segments.en: So he wanted to appreciate the graphics of his PlayStation 3 better, and that's why he wanted a new TV.
segments.zh: 所以他想更好地欣赏他的 PlayStation 3 的图形，这就是他想要一台新电视的原因。

segments.en: All right, or he could say, my computer has amazing graphics.
segments.zh: 好吧，或者他可以说，我的电脑有惊人的图形。

segments.en: It means games are really fun because they look good.
segments.zh: 这意味着游戏真的很有趣，因为它们看起来不错。

segments.en: Or this game has amazing graphics, so the game has places or scenery that looks really, really real.
segments.zh: 或者这个游戏有惊人的图形，所以游戏有看起来非常非常真实的地方或风景。

segments.en: All right, so graphics.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以图形。

segments.en: But some kinds of TVs are made to provide those wonderful graphics, and those are called HDTV.
segments.zh: 但是有些电视是为了提供那些精彩的图形而制作的，这些电视被称为高清电视。

segments.en: Right, an HDTV, or that's an acronym for high definition television.
segments.zh: 对，HDTV，也就是 high definition television（高清电视）的缩写。

segments.en: All right, and I heard some actors and actresses were complaining about HDTV because the picture quality is so good that you can see all of the little problems on their face, the little wrinkles and the pimples and the scars.
segments.zh: 好吧，我听到一些演员抱怨高清电视，因为画质非常好，你可以看到他们脸上的所有小问题，小皱纹、粉刺和疤痕。

segments.en: So be careful because one day we're going to be able to see way too much.
segments.zh: 所以要小心，因为有一天我们会看到太多。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So on high definition television, that's basically what you get is better definition, better level of graphics.
segments.zh: 所以在高清电视上，你得到的基本上就是更清晰的画面，更高水平的画质。

segments.en: So more pixels per inch, you can see a lot more clarity.
segments.zh: 所以每英寸的像素更多，你可以看到更多的清晰度。

segments.en: Right, so an HDTV.
segments.zh: 对，所以是高清电视。

segments.en: The next thing we're talking about is actually kind of related to the back part of your TV where you plug things in.
segments.zh: 我们正在谈论的下一件事实际上与电视的背面部分有关，您可以在其中插入东西。

segments.en: Sometimes it's on the side, sometimes it's on the back.
segments.zh: 有时它在侧面，有时在背面。

segments.en: Well, there are different names for different kinds of plugs.
segments.zh: 好吧，不同种类的插头有不同的名称。

segments.en: So today we're going to talk about two of those.
segments.zh: 所以今天我们将讨论其中的两个。

segments.en: One of them is USB.
segments.zh: 其中之一是USB。

segments.en: Right, this TV has a USB port, which basically stands for universal serial bus.
segments.zh: 对了，这台电视有一个USB端口，基本上代表通用串行总线。

segments.en: All right, so a port is a place where you plug something in.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以端口是您插入某物的地方。

segments.en: Your computer has a lot of ports as well.
segments.zh: 你的电脑也有很多端口。

segments.en: But USB is maybe more common for people who have iPods or computers because this is how we normally connect things to our computers.
segments.zh: 但对于拥有 iPod 或计算机的人来说，USB 可能更常见，因为这就是我们通常将事物连接到计算机的方式。

segments.en: So in this case, this television, you could connect maybe your iPod and reproduce videos or pictures onto the TV.
segments.zh: 所以这台电视，你可以接上你的 iPod，把视频或图片投到电视上播放。

segments.en: Awesome.
segments.zh: 太棒了。

segments.en: Or in the second case, we have a DVI port.
segments.zh: 或者在第二种情况下，我们有一个 DVI 端口。

segments.en: So DVI, you're going to have to tell me about this one, Marco, because I'm not so sure.
segments.zh: 所以 DVI 这个，Marco，得由你来告诉我了，因为我不太确定。

segments.en: Well, a DVI is basically a digital video input.
segments.zh: 好吧，DVI 基本上是数字视频输入。

segments.en: So basically you can connect your computer to the TV and see what's on your screen.
segments.zh: 所以基本上你可以把你的电脑连接到电视，看看你的屏幕上有什么。

segments.en: Nice.
segments.zh: 不错。

segments.en: And so if you have a bunch of movies stored on your computer, you can just plug it into the TV and watch.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您的计算机上存储了一堆电影，您只需将其插入电视并观看即可。

segments.en: Or you can even navigate the internet on a big screen TV.
segments.zh: 或者您甚至可以在大屏幕电视上浏览互联网。

segments.en: Cool.
segments.zh: 真不错。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So what are these three HDMI connectors?
segments.zh: 那么这三个HDMI连接器是什么？

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Well, this is a new technology.
segments.zh: 嗯，这是一项新技术。

segments.en: Basically, you know how before you used to get your DVD player, your VHS, and you had three cables, two for sound and one for video?
segments.zh: 基本上，你知道以前接 DVD 播放机、录像机时，要用三根线，两根传声音，一根传视频吧？

segments.en: Yeah, the red, yellow, and white cables.
segments.zh: 是的，红色、黄色和白色电缆。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So with this new type of cable or technology, with one cable, it takes all the information to the TV.
segments.zh: 因此，使用这种新型电缆或技术，使用一根电缆，它将所有信息都带到了电视上。

segments.en: So just one cable for everything.
segments.zh: 所以只有一根电缆用于一切。

segments.en: Oh, nice.
segments.zh: 哦，真不错。

segments.en: The problem is I always used to put the wrong cable in the wrong port, so I'd have the red cable in the yellow port, and then I'd say, where's the video?
segments.zh: 问题是我总是把错误的电缆放在错误的端口上，所以我会把红色的电缆放在黄色端口，然后我会说，视频在哪里？

segments.en: I can't see.
segments.zh: 我看不到。

segments.en: All I can do is listen.
segments.zh: 我所能做的就是倾听。

segments.en: Yeah, it happens.
segments.zh: 是啊，常有的事。

segments.en: So with this, now it's easy.
segments.zh: 所以有了这个，现在很容易。

segments.en: And well, it's a little bit more organized, because I remember I used to have a TV and I had a lot of different things connected to it.
segments.zh: 这样会整齐一些，因为我记得以前我的电视上接了很多不同的设备。

segments.en: It was just this big spider web in the back with all these cables.
segments.zh: 后面那些线就像一张大蜘蛛网。

segments.en: So an HDMI, high definition multimedia interface connector.
segments.zh: 所以一个HDMI高清多媒体接口连接器。

segments.en: And what else do we have?
segments.zh: 我们还有什么？

segments.en: Well, the last thing we're talking about is actually the place to put your TV.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们谈论的最后一件事实际上是放置电视的地方。

segments.en: So a lot of people now are putting their TVs on walls like paintings, because these TVs are so thin.
segments.zh: 所以现在很多人把电视像画一样放在墙上，因为这些电视太薄了。

segments.en: So we call this a wall mount.
segments.zh: 所以我们称之为壁挂式安装。

segments.en: So a mount, to mount something is also a verb, right?
segments.zh: 所以 mount，to mount something 里的 mount 也是动词，对吧？

segments.en: Yeah, it means to put something up or to hang something up.
segments.zh: 是的，这意味着把东西挂起来或挂起来。

segments.en: So many people like to mount their trophies to show off.
segments.zh: 很多人喜欢把奖杯挂起来炫耀。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So this is what we're doing with the TV.
segments.zh: 这就是我们在电视上所做的事情。

segments.en: We're going to mount it on the wall like a painting.
segments.zh: 我们要把它像一幅画一样挂在墙上。

segments.en: Cool.
segments.zh: 真不错。

segments.en: So those are our words for language takeaway.
segments.zh: 以上就是我们语言要点的词。

segments.zh: 这次我们要放慢速度，真正弄清楚发生了什么。

segments.zh: 说真的，我不知道为什么我们需要买一台新电视。

segments.zh: 亲爱的，我已经告诉过你了。

segments.zh: 用咱们的旧电视，根本看不出 PlayStation 3 游戏的画质和细节。

segments.zh: 大家下午好。

segments.zh: 今天有什么能为您效劳的？

segments.zh: 我想换一台更新、更大的电视。

segments.zh: 你来对地方了。

segments.zh: 你在找什么尺寸？

segments.zh: 只是客厅的普通大小的电视。

segments.en: I see.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.zh: 这台电视正在打折。

segments.en: It's a 46 inch HTTV screen and it has all the works.
segments.zh: 这是一台 46 英寸的 HTTV 屏幕，功能一应俱全。

segments.en: Three HDMI connectors, USB, VGA, and S-video ports.
segments.zh: 三个 HDMI 连接器、USB、VGA 和 S-Video 端口。

segments.en: It even has a DVI port so you can hook up your PC or laptop.
segments.zh: 它甚至有一个 DVI 端口，因此您可以连接您的 PC 或笔记本电脑。

segments.en: This is without a doubt the complete home theater experience.
segments.zh: 毫无疑问，这是完整的家庭影院体验。

segments.en: This is exactly what I need.
segments.zh: 这正是我所需要的。

segments.zh: 想想看，用这台电视看电影、玩游戏得多过瘾。

segments.en: Honey, I think it's a bit too big.
segments.zh: 亲爱的，我觉得有点太大了。

segments.en: I don't even think it will fit in our living room.
segments.zh: 我甚至觉得咱们客厅都放不下。

segments.en: Not to worry.
segments.zh: 别担心。

segments.en: We will deliver and install it in your home.
segments.zh: 我们会送货上门并安装。

segments.en: It comes with a wall mount so you can just hang it on the wall like a picture.
segments.zh: 它配有壁挂支架，可以像挂画一样挂在墙上。

segments.en: This is great.
segments.zh: 这太棒了。

segments.en: How much will this set me back?
segments.zh: 这台要花我多少钱？

segments.en: Lucky for you, this is the last one we have in stock so it's half off.
segments.zh: 算你走运，这是最后一台库存了，所以打五折。

segments.en: I'll take it.
segments.zh: 我要这个。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So now we're going to be taking a look at three different phrases that we saw in this dialogue in Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 所以现在我们将看看我们在流利表达的这次对话中看到的三个不同的短语。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: This first phrase is definitely one that I use a lot.
segments.zh: 第一个短语绝对是我经常使用的一个短语。

segments.en: We can talk about food.
segments.zh: 我们可以谈论食物。

segments.en: We can talk about electronics.
segments.zh: 我们可以谈论电子产品。

segments.en: We can talk about most different things.
segments.zh: 我们可以谈论大多数不同的事情。

segments.en: But the phrase here is the works.
segments.zh: 但这里的短语是 the works。

segments.en: He's getting the works.
segments.zh: 他是全套都要。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: That means any option he could get, any possibility, he wants it all.
segments.zh: 这意味着他可以得到的任何选择，任何可能性，他都想要这一切。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So if you're getting a new car, for example, right, you're getting the high definition sound system.
segments.zh: 因此，例如，如果您要买一辆新车，那么您将获得高清音响系统。

segments.en: You're getting nice tires, leather seats.
segments.zh: 你得到了漂亮的轮胎，真皮座椅。

segments.en: You're getting the works.
segments.zh: 你就是要全套。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Or if you're getting a hamburger and you want the works, you're getting it with cheese and lettuce and tomato and pepper and bacon and you know, it means every option you're getting it all.
segments.zh: 或者你点一个汉堡、要“全套”的，就会加奶酪、生菜、番茄、辣椒和培根，意思就是所有配料都要。

segments.en: The works.
segments.zh: The works，全套。

segments.en: So I think this word is so versatile that we should maybe listen to some more examples.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这个词是如此多才多艺，我们可能应该听更多的例子。

segments.en: Example one.
segments.zh: 例句一。

segments.en: The bridegroom was wearing a morning suit, top hat, gloves, the works.
segments.zh: 新郎穿着晨礼服、戴着高筒礼帽和手套，全套都齐了。

segments.en: Example two.
segments.zh: 例句二。

segments.en: He spent over $10,000 on his home theater system.
segments.zh: 他在家庭影院系统上花费了超过 10,000 美元。

segments.en: He got all the works.
segments.zh: 他全套都配齐了。

segments.en: Example three.
segments.zh: 例句三。

segments.en: I bought a new car with all the works, magnesium rims, custom paint and leather seats.
segments.zh: 我买了一辆新车，全套配置都有：镁合金轮毂、定制车漆和真皮座椅。

segments.en: So now that we've seen the works on the home theater system, he needs to hook it up.
segments.zh: 好，我们已经了解了家庭影院系统的全套配置，现在他得把它接起来。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So this is an important part and a very exciting part of a new purchase.
segments.zh: 因此，这是新购买的重要部分和非常令人兴奋的部分。

segments.en: So when you buy something, you have to hook it up.
segments.zh: 所以买了东西，你得把它连接好。

segments.en: That means you have to plug things together.
segments.zh: 就是把各个设备连起来。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So we plug things into the wall for electricity, but also hook up maybe those, those cores you were talking about earlier, that HDMI connector, that's called hooking up or connecting.
segments.zh: 所以我们会把插头插到墙上取电，也会把之前说的那些线、那个 HDMI 接口连起来，这就叫 hooking up，也就是连接。

segments.en: So you would hook up your DVD player to your television.
segments.zh: 所以你会把你的 DVD 播放器连接到你的电视上。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: I could ask you, did you hook up those new speakers to your big TV yesterday?
segments.zh: 我可以问你，你昨天有没有把那些新扬声器连接到你的大电视上？

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So to connect, it's another way of saying to connect.
segments.zh: 所以 hook up 就是 to connect 的另一种说法。

segments.en: And finally, the, the big event when you're buying something is the end when you have to actually pay.
segments.zh: 最后，当你买东西时，大事件是你必须实际付款的终点。

segments.en: And this guy's a little bit worried that the things he wants cost a lot of money.
segments.zh: 而这家伙有点担心他想要的东西要花很多钱。

segments.en: So he asks a really great question.
segments.zh: 所以他问了一个非常好的问题。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: He said, how much will this set me back?
segments.zh: 他说，这要花我多少钱？

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: This sounds a little weird at first, because you could just say, how much will this cost?
segments.zh: 一开始听起来有点奇怪，因为你可以说，这要花多少钱？

segments.en: But he's speaking in a very colloquial way, very familiar.
segments.zh: 但他说话的方式非常通俗，非常熟悉。

segments.en: And he says, how much will this set me back?
segments.zh: 他说，这要花我多少钱？

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So how much will this cost me?
segments.zh: 那么这要花多少钱？

segments.en: So how much am I actually going to spend?
segments.zh: 那么我实际上要花多少钱？

segments.en: So it's just a different way of saying how much does it cost?
segments.zh: 所以这只是一种不同的方式来表达它的成本是多少？

segments.en: But it's like you say, more colloquial.
segments.zh: 但这就像你说的，更口语。

segments.en: It's a lot more native-like.
segments.zh: 听起来更像母语者。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And so if you're writing your paper, you don't want to write this, this will set you back $500 in economics.
segments.zh: 所以如果你在写论文，你不会写“this will set you back $500”这种句子。

segments.en: But we'd say this in spoken language in our normal daily lives with friends.
segments.zh: 但我们会在与朋友的正常日常生活中用口语来表达这一点。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to a couple more examples of set me back.
segments.zh: 那我们再听几个 set me back 的例子吧。

segments.en: Example one.
segments.zh: 例句一。

segments.en: This unexpected expense is going to set us back a couple thousand dollars.
segments.zh: 这笔意外的开销要让我们多花好几千美元。

segments.en: Example two.
segments.zh: 例句二。

segments.en: That fancy dinner at the restaurant last night really set us back.
segments.zh: 昨晚在餐厅的那顿大餐真的让我们破费了。

segments.en: Example three.
segments.zh: 例句三。

segments.en: I feel guilty about buying this coat.
segments.zh: 我对买这件外套感到内疚。

segments.en: It set me back over $300.
segments.zh: 它花了我 300 多美元。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Great.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: So now that we've taken a look at those great phrases and with some good examples, why don't we listen to this dialogue one last time.
segments.zh: 所以现在我们已经看了那些很棒的短语和一些很好的例子，我们为什么不听听这次对话。

segments.en: Seriously, I don't know why we need to get a new TV.
segments.zh: 说真的，我不知道为什么我们需要买一台新电视。

segments.en: Honey, I told you already.
segments.zh: 亲爱的，我已经告诉过你了。

segments.en: I can't appreciate the graphics level and detail of the games on my PlayStation 3 on our old TV.
segments.zh: 用咱们的旧电视，根本看不出 PlayStation 3 游戏的画质和细节。

segments.en: Good afternoon, folks.
segments.zh: 大家下午好。

segments.en: How can I be of service today?
segments.zh: 今天有什么能为您效劳的？

segments.en: I'm looking to upgrade to a newer, bigger television set.
segments.zh: 我想换一台更新、更大的电视。

segments.en: You've come to the right place.
segments.zh: 你来对地方了。

segments.en: What size are you looking for?
segments.zh: 你在找什么尺寸？

segments.en: Just a normal size TV for a living room.
segments.zh: 就是一台客厅用的普通尺寸电视。

segments.en: I see.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: Well, this set here is on sale.
segments.zh: 这台电视正在打折。

segments.en: It's a 46 inch HT TV screen and it has all the works.
segments.zh: 这是一个 46 英寸的 HT 电视屏幕，它拥有所有作品。

segments.en: Three HDMI connectors, USB, VGA and S video ports.
segments.zh: 三个 HDMI 连接器，USB、VGA 和 S 视频端口。

segments.en: It even has a DVI port so you can hook up your PC or laptop.
segments.zh: 它甚至有一个 DVI 端口，因此您可以连接您的 PC 或笔记本电脑。

segments.en: This is without a doubt, the complete home theater experience.
segments.zh: 毫无疑问，这是完整的家庭影院体验。

segments.en: This is exactly what I need.
segments.zh: 这正是我所需要的。

segments.en: Can you imagine watching movies or playing video games on this thing?
segments.zh: 想想看，用这台电视看电影、玩游戏得多过瘾。

segments.en: Honey, I think it's a bit too big.
segments.zh: 亲爱的，我觉得有点太大了。

segments.en: I don't even think it will fit in our living room.
segments.zh: 我甚至觉得咱们客厅都放不下。

segments.en: Not to worry.
segments.zh: 别担心。

segments.en: We will deliver and install it in your home.
segments.zh: 我们会送货上门并安装。

segments.en: It comes with a wall mount so you can just hang it on the wall like a picture.
segments.zh: 它配有壁挂支架，可以像挂画一样挂在墙上。

segments.en: This is great.
segments.zh: 这太棒了。

segments.en: How much will this set me back?
segments.zh: 这台要花我多少钱？

segments.en: Lucky for you, this is the last one we have in stock so it's half off.
segments.zh: 算你走运，这是最后一台库存了，所以打五折。

segments.en: I'll take it.
segments.zh: 我要这个。

segments.en: Okay, so a big TV, I think, I don't know, I think it's just a great thing to have at home.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我想一台大电视，我不知道，我认为这只是一件很棒的事情。

segments.en: Not to, you know, spend too much time in front of the TV but it's good to sit down and watch a movie.
segments.zh: 不是说要在电视机前花太多时间，但坐下来看场电影还是不错的。

segments.en: It's nice because now there's so many different things you can do with it.
segments.zh: 这很好，因为现在你可以用它做很多不同的事情。

segments.en: You can hook up your computer, you can buy a projector, you can play your PS3 or your Wii.
segments.zh: 你可以连接你的电脑，你可以买一台投影仪，你可以玩你的 PS3 或你的 Wii。

segments.en: So I think there's a lot to do and it's just wonderful how great graphics have come in just like the last five years.
segments.zh: 所以我觉得能玩的东西很多，短短五年里画质就发展到这么好，真了不起。

segments.en: What do you think about having a television set, for example, in the bathroom?
segments.zh: 例如，您如何看待在浴室里安装电视机？

segments.en: I would say it's a really bad idea but I think, well, if I have a bathtub, I think it would be really cool.
segments.zh: 我会说这是一个非常糟糕的主意，但我认为，好吧，如果我有浴缸，我认为这真的很酷。

segments.en: What about, you know, some people don't like having a television set in their bedroom.
segments.zh: 怎么样，你知道，有些人不喜欢在他们的卧室里放一台电视机。

segments.en: I agree with this.
segments.zh: 我同意这一点。

segments.en: Why?
segments.zh: 为什么？

segments.en: I agree.
segments.zh: 我同意。

segments.en: Because I think it's really important that you have peace and quiet in your bedroom because it's kind of like, for me, it's an important space where I can just relax and be quiet and I like reading a lot so if I have a TV, maybe I'll watch more TV but I'd much rather read a book before bed.
segments.zh: 因为我觉得卧室里能有份安宁清静真的很重要，对我来说，那是一个能放松、安静待着的重要空间；我很喜欢读书，所以如果有电视，我也许多看些电视，但睡前我更愿意读本书。

segments.en: True.
segments.zh: 确实。

segments.en: Yeah, I definitely agree but, you know, I've seen people that have TVs in their living rooms, in their dining rooms, even in their kitchen so they're watching something while they're cooking and even in the bathroom.
segments.zh: 是的，我绝对同意，但是，你知道，我见过人们在他们的客厅、餐厅里甚至在厨房里都有电视，所以他们在做饭的时候甚至在浴室里都看东西。

segments.en: Like you say, in a bathtub, well, it's nice but some of them I've seen in front of the toilet or something.
segments.zh: 就像你说的，浴室里放电视，嗯，是不错，但我见过有人把它放在马桶前面之类的。

segments.en: Oh, no.
segments.zh: 哦，不。

segments.en: I would say that the one in the kitchen is nice because if you spend a lot of time in the kitchen, you can watch the news while you're cooking or you can actually watch cooking shows and try and practice.
segments.zh: 我会说厨房里的一个很好，因为如果你在厨房里花很多时间，你可以在做饭的时候看新闻，或者你可以实际观看烹饪节目并尝试练习。

segments.en: Or soap operas.
segments.zh: 或肥皂剧。

segments.en: Or soap operas.
segments.zh: 或肥皂剧。

segments.en: So I guess it depends on the person.
segments.zh: 所以我想这取决于人。

segments.en: It depends on how much you watch TV.
segments.zh: 这取决于你看电视看多少。

segments.en: But I'm curious to know what our listeners have to say about TVs and big electronics purchases.
segments.zh: 但我很想知道我们的听众对电视和大型电子产品的购买有什么看法。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So come to our website EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 所以来我们的网站 englishpod.com。

segments.en: If you have any questions or any doubts regarding the lesson or any suggestions, you can let us know.
segments.zh: 如果你对课程有任何疑问，或者有任何建议，都可以告诉我们。

segments.en: Otherwise, we'll be there to just talk and practice that English and of course send us your suggestions for future lessons.
segments.zh: 不然的话，我们也会在上面聊天、练习英语，当然也欢迎你给我们发来对以后课程的建议。

segments.en: We love to know what you're interested in learning about.
segments.zh: 我们很想知道您有兴趣了解什么。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 到时候在那里见。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Take care.
segments.zh: 保重。
